title: Count Islands With Total Value Divisible by K
summary: Given an m x n matrix grid and a positive integer k, count the number of islands where the sum of the values in each island is divisible by k.
statement: Given an m x n matrix grid and a positive integer k, count the number of islands where the sum of the values in each island is divisible by k.
constraints: The grid has at most 100,000 cells.
Positive cells form four-neighbor islands; zero is water.
Count islands whose value sum is divisible by positive k.
hints: Each positive cell belongs to one four-neighbor component.
Flood-fill every unseen land cell while accumulating its values.
After each component traversal, test its sum modulo k.
The traversals partition all land cells into exactly the defined islands, each counted once.
editorial: The traversals partition all land cells into exactly the defined islands, each counted once.

tests.explanation: Exactly two of the four island sums are divisible by five.
Six isolated value-three islands all qualify.
